SELECT dc.company_id, dc.company_name, dc.parent_company_id, parent.company_name AS parent_company_name, CASE WHEN dc.parent_company_id IS NULL THEN 'FIRST_LEVEL' ELSE 'SECOND_LEVEL' END AS level, dc.company_status, dc.company_synced_at, dc.created_at, dc.updated_at FROM dealer_company dc LEFT JOIN dealer_company parent ON parent.company_id = dc.parent_company_id
AND dc.company_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND dc.company_status = #{status}
AND dc.parent_company_id = #{parentCompanyId}
AND dc.parent_company_id IS NULL
AND dc.parent_company_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY dc.created_at DESC, dc.company_id DESC

SELECT partner.company_id, partner.company_name, partner.company_status, CASE WHEN current_company.parent_company_id IS NULL THEN 'CHILD' ELSE 'PARENT' END AS relationship_type FROM dealer_company current_company JOIN dealer_company partner ON (current_company.parent_company_id IS NULL AND partner.parent_company_id = current_company.company_id) OR (current_company.parent_company_id IS NOT NULL AND partner.company_id = current_company.parent_company_id) WHERE current_company.company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY partner.company_id
